body:
# brlw's Anti Ghost Gap

A lightweight client-side Fabric mod for version 1.21.11 that eliminates ghost golden apples by forcing a release at the exact tick consumption completes, and lets you hold right-click to continuously eat back-to-back- unlike [Xicz Gap Releaser](https://modrinth.com/mod/xiczgapreleaser) which does prevent ghost gaps the same that this mod does, but does not let you eat continuously.

### **The Problem**

Golden apples take **32 ticks (1.6 seconds)** to eat. In unmodded Minecraft, after the timer hits zero, the client keeps holding right-click until the server responds with confirmation. On any amount of latency, those extra ticks of holding can desync the client and server — You ate the golden apple on your screen, but the server didn't detect it. That's a ghost gap.

### **How It Works**
- Tracks client-side eat timer — monitors itemUseTimeLeft while you're eating a golden apple
- Waits for server confirmation — listens for inventory slot update packets from the server, which confirm the item was actually consumed
- Force-releases at the perfect tick — the instant both conditions are met (timer expired + server confirmed), it sets useKey to false, stopping the eat cleanly with zero over-hold
- Hold-to-gap — after the force-release, if you're still physically holding right-click and have another golden apple, it immediately re-initiates eating on the next tick with no delay
- This is the same proven approach used by mods like Xicz Gap Releaser and Optimal Eat, but with hold-to-gap built in and no messages in the action bar.

### **Features:**

- Auto-release at the exact completion tick (no ghost gaps)
- Hold right-click to continuously eat golden apples back-to-back
- Toggle the entire mod on/off with a keybind
- Works with both regular and enchanted golden apples
- Client-side only, no server modifications needed
